result.markdown: # Cheat-Sheet Index {#sec-cheat-index .unnumbered} Each content chapter ends with a two-column reference table of the commands, rules, and terms introduced in that chapter. This appendix lists what each table covers, part by part, with a reference to the full table, where the surrounding context explains any term that is not self-explanatory. The entries below are read from the chapters' own tables when the book is built, so the index cannot fall out of step with them. ## Foundations **@sec-crisis, The Reproducibility Crisis** (@sec-cheat-crisis). Reproducibility; Replicability; Robustness; Computational failure; Statistical failure; `RNGkind()`; `stringsAsFactors`; Determinant stack; Floor, not ceiling; Honest level; Record model use (@sec-llm-disclosure). **@sec-levels, Levels of Reproducibility** (@sec-cheat-levels). L0 locatable; L1 pinned packages; L2 pinned environment; L3 verified; Capture vs. validation; Reproduced (this book); `zzc verify --full` (zzcollab); Honest statement. ## Getting Set Up **[Shell Primer](shell-primer.qmd)**. No table; the page itself is the reference. **[Setting Up Your Machine](setup-appendix.qmd)**. No table; the page itself is the reference. ## Organizing the Work **@sec-version-control, Version Control with Git and GitHub** (@sec-cheat-vc). `git init -b main`; `git add `; `git commit -m '...'`; `git status`; `git log --oneline`; `git show `; `git switch -c `; `git remote add origin `; `git push -u origin main`; `git tag -a v1.0 -m '...'`; `!pattern` in `.gitignore`; `git check-ignore -v `; `git rm --cached `; Git refuses; `git filter-repo --sensitive-data-removal`. **@sec-compendium, The Research Compendium** (@sec-cheat-compendium). `DESCRIPTION`, `NAMESPACE`, `R/`; `.Rbuildignore` entry `^analysis$`; The Five Pillars; 'If I deleted this file, could the code regenerate it?'; Five archetypes; Progressive disclosure; `usethis::create_package()`, `use_r()`, `use_package()`; `tinytest::setup_tinytest('.')`; `devtools::load_all()`, `document()`, `check()`; README computational requirements. ## Capturing the Environment **@sec-dependencies, Pinning Packages with renv** (@sec-cheat-deps). `renv::init()`; `renv::snapshot()`; `renv::restore()`; `renv::dependencies(files)`; `renv::status()`; `Rscript -e 'if (!renv::status()$synchronized) quit(status = 1)'`; `options(repos = c(CRAN = '.../cran/YYYY-MM-DD'))`; `renv::sysreqs(pkgs, distro = 'ubuntu:22.04')`. **@sec-containers, Pinning the Environment with Docker** (@sec-cheat-containers). `FROM image@sha256:...`; `ARG PPM_SNAPSHOT=.../jammy/YYYY-MM-DD`; `ENV RENV_CONFIG_REPOS_OVERRIDE=...`; `ENV LANG=... LC_ALL=...`; `ENV TZ=UTC`; `ENV OMP_NUM_THREADS=1`, `OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1`; `WORKDIR /project`; `RUN apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ...`; `docker system df`, `docker image prune`; `COPY renv.lock renv.lock` + `renv::restore()`; `docker build --platform linux/amd64`; `docker buildx imagetools inspect image:tag`; `docker image inspect --format '{{index .RepoDigests 0}}' image:tag`. ## Validation **@sec-literate, Literate Programming and the Rendered Report** (@sec-cheat-literate). `library(pkg)`, one per package; An inline R expression in prose; `execute:` in the YAML header; `format: typst`; `date: today`; `quarto render notebook.ipynb --execute`; `SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH`; `make docker-render` (zzcollab); Five landmines; `freeze: auto`. **@sec-pipelines, Automating the Analysis: targets and Make** (@sec-cheat-pipelines). `tar_target(x, expr)`; `tar_target(x, path, format = 'file')`; `tar_source('R')`; `tar_make()`; `tar_outdated()`; `tar_visnetwork()`; `tar_render()` / `tar_quarto()`; Rule: `target: prerequisites`; Make recipe line; `make`; `touch file`; Capture vs. validation; Honest claim; LLM response cache. **@sec-testing, Testing and Code Quality** (@sec-cheat-testing). `expect_equal(a, e)`; `expect_equal(a, e, tolerance = 1e-8)`; `expect_true()`, `expect_false()`, `expect_identical()`, `expect_error()`, `expect_inherits()`; `tinytest::test_package('pkg')`; `exit_file('message')`; `LINTR_ERROR_ON_LINT=true Rscript -e 'lintr::lint_dir("R")'`; `Rscript -e 'styler::style_dir("R")'`; `if (!tinytest::all_pass(r)) quit(status = 1)`; Code review, six questions (@sec-code-review). **@sec-verification, Continuous Integration and Verification** (@sec-cheat-ci). `error-on: '"warning"'` (GitHub) / `error_on = "warning"` (`rcmdcheck`); `Rscript ci/dependency-gate.R`; `uses: actions/checkout@ # v7.0.1`; `renv::dependencies('analysis')`; `rmarkdown::render(...)` in a CI step; `docker build -t compendium:ci .`; `test-baseline-*.R` naming; `digest(file = path, algo = 'sha256')`; `.Rbuildignore` entry for `analysis/`. ## Collaboration and Stewardship **@sec-archiving, Collaboration, Archiving, and Stewardship** (@sec-cheat-archiving). `docker inspect --format '{{index .RepoDigests 0}}' `; `docker run --rm find /project -type f`; `apptainer build out.sif docker://@sha256:...`; `renv.lock` + `Dockerfile`, committed; Two-layer model; Union lockfile; `rang::resolve(pkgs, snapshot_date = ...)`; Recorded run date; Restricted data (@sec-restricted-deposit); DOI deposit; Honest claim at deposit; Trusted research environment (@sec-tre); CONSORT 2025 item 4, SPIRIT 2025 item 6. ## Appendices **@sec-backends, Backends and Runtimes: Nix, Podman, and Apptainer** (@sec-cheat-backends). `podman run --platform linux/amd64 ...`; `apptainer build --arch amd64 x.sif docker://img@sha256:...`; `apptainer exec --cleanenv --no-home --bind "$PWD" x.sif Rscript --vanilla ...`; `rix::rix(r_ver=, r_pkgs=, project_path=)`; `nix-shell default.nix`; `.binder/Dockerfile`; `.devcontainer/devcontainer.json`.
